clues: It is calculated as the ratio of carbon dioxide produced to oxygen consumed during substrate oxidation.
Complete oxidation of glucose yields a value of 1.0, whereas fatty acid oxidation yields roughly 0.7.
Abbreviated RQ, this metabolic ratio helps estimate the relative mix of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins being oxidized.
It is a vitamin A aldehyde derivative covalently linked via a Schiff base to opsin in rod cells.
Absorption of light converts it into the all-trans isomer, triggering the phototransduction cascade.
Depletion of this chromophore impairs dim-light vision and causes night blindness.
Abbreviated PTH, it is secreted by parathyroid chief cells in response to low extracellular calcium.
It promotes renal calcium reabsorption, increases urinary phosphate excretion, and stimulates renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase.
This endocrine peptide acts on bone and kidney to raise serum calcium levels.

terms.sub: Iron, Copper, Zinc, and Iodine Metabolism
clues: It is an alpha-2-glycoprotein synthesized in the liver that carries most of the copper in human plasma.
Its ferroxidase activity oxidizes Fe2+ to Fe3+ so iron can bind transferrin.
Serum levels of this protein are typically low in Wilson disease.
